mechanism: Deutetrabenazine is a VMAT2 inhibitor that increases dopamine in synaptic clefts and may have theoretical additive CNS effects; estradiol can influence dopaminergic tone and potentially affect neurotransmitter metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased dopaminergic side effects including akathisia, restlessness, or mood changes; dosing adjustments of deutetrabenazine may be necessary based on clinical response and tolerability.
